lines.en: I scuttle sideways, and fast.

lines.zh: 我的两只大螯举在前面
lines.en: Both big claws held out front.
My shell carries a dull red.
I climb from the shallows onto the bank.

lines.zh: 每走几步，我就停下来看
lines.en: Every few steps I stop and look.
My tail curls beneath me.
I shove a stone aside with a claw.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸边巡，像在守什么
lines.en: I patrol the bank as if guarding it.
I sidle closer without backing down.
Mud pits under each step.
I push through the reeds.
I head for the movement at the water.
I stand at the water's edge, claws half raised.
Waterweed clings to my shell.
I listen to what moves underwater.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，水从壳上滑下去
lines.en: I shudder, and water runs off my shell.
This stretch of shallows is mine.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把一只螯抬起来
lines.en: I raise one claw slowly.
My eye stalks swivel.
A string of bubbles in the mud.

lines.zh: 我不需要躲，我在这儿够大
lines.en: I need not hide; I am big enough here.
My underside presses the wet mud.
I wait for something to come to the water.
An old chip marks my shell's edge.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去，露出侧甲
lines.en: I turn broadside, showing my side plate.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃了我一下
lines.en: The light on the water flickers at me.
I raise both claws.
You are larger, but I do not yield.
My eye stalks turn to you.
You stepped into my stretch of water.
I keep these shallows.
I sidle around to your flank.
My claws are open.

lines.zh: 你要过去，得从我这边绕
lines.en: To pass, you must go around me.
The water is behind me; a good way out.
Only shallow water lies between us.
I clack my claws once.
You stepped back half a pace; that is right.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，螯护在身前
lines.en: I step back, claws in front.
My shell rings from the blow.
I do not cry out; I clack my claws.
One claw is askew, still usable.
I retreat half a meter through the mud.
That blow left my claws numb.
I turn broadside and face you with my shell.
I give half a foot in the mud water.

lines.zh: 水在我身后，我会退进去
lines.en: Water is behind me; I will fall back into it.
You have angered me.
There is a smell in the water.
I angle my body that way.
I could crush this.
Put it in the water and I will get it.
Do not let go; I am going to snap.
My claws are more useful than my mouth.
That is not enough.
I pinch it and drag it back.
Your hand is too close to the water.
I back away slowly, carrying it.
You charge; I turn broadside and hold.

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，撞上来你自己疼
lines.en: My shell is hard; the impact hurts you.
The hit sinks me into the rotten mud.

lines.zh: 螯撞在你腿上，你没站稳
lines.en: My claw catches your leg; you stagger.
Muddy water splashes over us both.
I sidle back and block the way.
One tail segment jammed.

lines.zh: 你退到水里，我也跟进去
lines.en: You back into the water; I follow.
I know this ground.
You can push me, but not far.
There is another at the water's edge, smaller.
We touch claws.
The one at the water's edge, I leave alone.

lines.zh: 这一片浅滩够我们两个
lines.en: These shallows are enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 我们一起守，谁也别想进来
lines.en: We guard together; nothing gets in.
She keeps the east, I the west.
We do not fight; there is enough in the water.
Two shells shine in the water.
When she left, I did not follow.

lines.zh: 同类之间，碰一下螯就够了
lines.en: Between kin, one touch of claws is enough.
I pinch it and hold it up.
It weighs more than my claw.
My grip fails and it drops in the mud.
This shell is too slippery to hold.
I lift with both claws.
I carry it into the shallows.
One squeeze and it broke.
I wedge it in a rock gap.
I have no use for this.
I back away with it held.
Something moves at the water's edge.
I sidle that way.
It has entered what I guard.
I do not warn; I clamp.
Two scuttles and I am there.
Smaller than me; just right.
I lift both claws above the water.
The water parts for me.

lines.zh: 它退到岸上，我跟着上去
lines.en: It backs onto land; I follow.
I have picked this bite.
I tap my shell once.
I will not come away empty.
I am at its flank, unseen.
It stands still; good.
I am speeding up.
Did you hear the claws?

lines.zh: 我横着跟着它，一步不落
lines.en: I follow it sideways, never falling behind.
It circles the stone; so do I.
My claws stay pointed at it.
I am quicker in the water.
It retreats; I close in.

lines.zh: 我用螯敲石头，声音很响
lines.en: I strike a stone with my claw; it rings loud.
Nothing else lives in this patch.
Its shadow is on the water's surface.
I block its way ashore.
I wait for it to tire first.
One more foot forward.
It is nearly out of breath.
I press it to the stone.
Deep water lies beyond the stone.
When it turns, I strike.
At last, I stop.
I raise my claws as high as they go.
One claw comes down.
The other claw snaps after it.
This pinch could take a finger off.

lines.zh: 你被夹住，甩了两下才脱开
lines.en: Caught, you shake twice to break free.
I sidle back one step.

lines.zh: 我的壳挡住了你的膝盖
lines.en: My shell catches your knee.

lines.zh: 我又举起螯，准备第二次
lines.en: I raise the claws for a second try.

lines.zh: 泥水被我们搅得一塌糊涂
lines.en: We churn the mud water to a mess.
That missed.
I back into the water and re-aim.
My tail curls tight.
I clamp your trouser leg and hold.
The second pinch is more accurate.
Two steps and you must stop.

lines.zh: 浅水里多了一个暗红的影子
lines.en: A dull red shape appears in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我扒开泥，露出暗红的壳。
lines.en: I claw the mud aside and show my dull red shell.
This stretch of bank suits me.
My claws break the surface first.
The water is murky; good cover.
I raise my claws and look around.

lines.zh: 我从浑水里浮出半个壳。
lines.en: Half my shell breaks the murky surface.

lines.zh: 这里的东西不多，但够我守
lines.en: Not much here, but enough to guard.
I grip the stones at the bank.

lines.zh: 我往深一点的地方退了退
lines.en: I back into slightly deeper water.

lines.zh: 我看见岸边的水纹不对。
lines.en: The ripples at the bank look wrong.

lines.zh: 我转过身，把螯对着声音
lines.en: I turn and face the sound, claws up.
One stir of mine muddies the water.

lines.zh: 我挑了一处能守住的口子
lines.en: I choose a gap I can hold.
These shallows are mine today.
I go quiet and wait.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，我跳进水里
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell; I drop into the water.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔进浅水，壳磕在石上
lines.en: I fall into the shallows; my shell hits stone.

lines.zh: 水太深了，我的腿够不到底
lines.en: The water is too deep; my legs cannot reach bottom.

lines.zh: 我被炸得壳朝下摔在泥里。
lines.en: The blast drops me shell-down in the mud.
An arrow lodges in my side plate.
That force locks my claws.

lines.zh: 水边空了，我什么也没夹到
lines.en: The bank is empty; I caught nothing.

lines.zh: 雷打进浅水，我整个壳都在抖
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows; my whole shell shakes.
No water left, and no mud.
